comment: The distinction between the LHR and facility-level EMR or EHR systems is directionally clear but insufficient for platforms that combine local clinical workflows with regional or national longitudinal records.

anchor.note: p.155 read as the printed page, no line resolved; in the cited section

public.text: The distinction between the LHR and facility-level EMR or EHR systems is directionally clear but insufficient for platforms that combine local clinical workflows with regional or national longitudinal records.
public.suggestedRevision: State that classification applies to the logical capability rather than the entire software product. One platform may realise both operational EHR functionality and LHR services, provided their responsibilities, data ownership, interfaces, and conformance boundaries remain separable.
